al_atomic_fine_structure_diagnostic.inspection: NIST persistent-line level table inspected on 2026-11-02.
al_atomic_fine_structure_diagnostic.interpretation: The possible term-center correction is about 0.0093 eV. The 1979 abstract does not identify its asymptote convention; this correction is therefore conditional, not applied to the model.

barklem_collet2016_table1.record_source: Frozen major_molecule_reference.json; column meanings checked against original paper Table 1 and Section 2.1.1.
barklem_collet2016_table1.limitation: The specific original sources behind the Luo AlH entry have not been inspected. Its similarity to JANAF is not proof of common ancestry.

assessment: The primary De result, after an approximately 0.1034 eV zero-point correction, favors a D0 near the NASA-derived 3.0502 eV over the JANAF-derived 2.9418 eV. A possible approximately 0.0093 eV atomic reference shift is too small to explain the roughly 0.11 eV NASA/JANAF difference. This supports a conditional preference for the NASA-side energy, but does not certify its exact value or the complete NASA thermal function. Do not use the later 3.16 eV D0 quotation as an independently verified threshold.
